description: TeamRankings team stat table for NBA or NFL, for one stat page (for example points-per-game): rank, team, the season value, last 3 games, last game, home and away averages, and the previous season, as TeamRankings publishes them. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
